compliment: 521 Google reviews at 4.7 is a huge reputation for a local company.
gap: Your website isn't keeping up with it, though. On a phone, barrhavens.com opens to a small logo on a mostly blank screen, it still says "©2018 by Barrhavens.ca, created with Wix" at the bottom, and someone has to scroll to find out what you do.
pitch_line: It leads with the 521 reviews, lays out design-build, lawn care and snow removal clearly, and has a free estimate form and a tap-to-call button.
